bio_en: Vahan Pastrmajian, called 'Kapiten' by friends in the Place des Fetes district of Paris, had served as a company commander and was respected by both Armenian and Turkish soldiers. A natural storyteller, he was a popular figure among the natives of Karin (Erzurum) in Paris. He died in Paris in 1960, and his funeral was reported in Haratch on 2 July 1960.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Relationship to Armen Garo (Garegin Pastermadjian) is implied by a link but not confirmed in the portion read.
